title: The Leaf Skeleton
youtube_title: The Leaf Skeleton | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Not every treasure needs to be pocketed.
summary: At a bedroom window on a frosty morning, Noemi finds a leaf skeleton as fine as a map. The wish to pocket it or poke it is real, but Noemi shows Priya how to look without disturbing it. Auntie June looks too, and they leave it where it is.
